title: Mother & Child, Backyard Garden Wooden Fence - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic black-and-white snapshot with deckled edges depicting a woman and a young child in a backyard setting, circa 1950. The woman wears a collared, button-front belted dress with short sleeves and a 1940s-1950s hairstyle, leaning lightly against a tall vertical wooden plank fence. In front of her stands a small child with curly hair facing away from the camera. In the background, tall stalks of blooming flowers rise above the fence line alongside a detached wooden garage or shed.
